# CCorex

> CCorex is construction software for MEP, fire-protection and main contractors in Singapore and India: tender estimating, drawing take-off, project cost control, and HR & payroll on one sign-in, with an AI assistant (ARIVU) in every app. Made by Newham Solutions Pte. Ltd., Singapore.

## Apps
DeepCost, DeepTrack and DeepHR are each sold on their own (Starter, Growth and Enterprise tiers) or together as a suite on one sign-in.

- [DeepCost](https://ccorex.com/products/deepcost): MEP tender estimating — AI tender summary, area schedules, material take-off, a priced library, and FOT AI on the client's BOQ PDF.
- [DeepPlan AI](https://ccorex.com/products/deepplan-ai): drawing take-off — rooms, measurements and symbol counts from floor plans into a priced BOQ (AI take-off in early access).
- [DeepTrack](https://ccorex.com/products/deeptrack): project delivery and cost control — budgets, budget against actual by workhead, WBS and cost centre, purchasing, invoice matching, client claims, month-end cost allocation. ARIVU AI answers questions about projects, budgets (against committed and actual cost), purchase requests, client claims, timesheets and delivery orders, read-only. In early access: AI budget overrun forecast and AI invoice auto-capture from vendor invoice PDFs.
- [DeepHR](https://ccorex.com/products/deephr): HR and payroll software for Singapore SMEs — face and GPS attendance on the employee's phone, leave, claims, Singapore payroll (CPF, SDL, SHG). ARIVU AI answers questions about employees, leave balances, attendance and expense claims, read-only and role-aware; it does not run or change payroll. In early access: AI receipt scan for expense claims and AI attendance anomaly alerts.
- [ARIVU AI](https://ccorex.com/products/arivu-ai): read-only, role-aware AI assistant that answers questions from your own organisation's data across the apps, with charts and Excel or PDF exports. Included in every CCorex plan, including a single app on its own.
- [Deep Drive](https://ccorex.com/products/deep-drive): project document storage.
- [PDF Editor](https://ccorex.com/products/pdf-editor): mark up, sign, split and merge PDFs.

## Solutions for Singapore contractors
- [MEP estimating and BOQ software](https://ccorex.com/products/deepcost) (DeepCost), with trade pages for [fire protection](https://ccorex.com/estimating/fire-protection) (sprinkler, fire alarm, gas suppression, firestopping and fireproofing), [ACMV](https://ccorex.com/estimating/acmv), [ELV](https://ccorex.com/estimating/elv), [electrical](https://ccorex.com/estimating/electrical) and [plumbing & sanitary](https://ccorex.com/estimating/plumbing-sanitary). Price libraries for every trade: Fire Protection, ACMV, A&A and ELV come seeded; electrical, plumbing & sanitary and other trades are set up during onboarding or imported from Excel
- [Tender estimating software](https://ccorex.com/solutions/tender-estimating-software) (DeepCost): AI tender summary, take-off by area, one price library, approvals at each stage and FOT AI on the client's BOQ PDF.
- [Construction cost control software](https://ccorex.com/solutions/construction-cost-control-software) (DeepTrack)
- [Progress claim software](https://ccorex.com/solutions/progress-claim-software) (DeepTrack)
- [HR software for construction](https://ccorex.com/solutions/construction-hr-software) (DeepHR)
- [Construction payroll software](https://ccorex.com/solutions/construction-payroll-software) (DeepHR)
- [Foreign worker attendance app](https://ccorex.com/solutions/foreign-worker-attendance-app) (DeepHR)
- [Project cost management software](https://ccorex.com/solutions/project-cost-management-software) (DeepTrack, for contractors): approved budgets, budget against actual, purchases to POs, invoice matching, timesheet labour, SGD with 9% GST.
- [Procurement and purchase order software](https://ccorex.com/solutions/procurement-software-singapore) (DeepTrack, for contractors): purchase requests against budgets, approval limits, purchase orders, delivery endorsement, invoice matching.
- [Quantity take-off software for PDF drawings](https://ccorex.com/solutions/quantity-takeoff-software): DeepPlan AI. Upload PDF drawings, calibrate the scale, measure rooms, price from a rate library and export the BOQ; AI take-off is in early access.

## Solutions for Singapore businesses in any sector
- [Expense claim software for Singapore](https://ccorex.com/solutions/expense-claim-software-singapore) (DeepHR): claims in SGD with a receipt on the phone, multi-level approvals with an extra level above a set amount, marked paid, claims register; AI receipt scan in early access.
DeepHR is also sold on its own to Singapore SMEs in any sector, especially teams with staff on site or on the move. DeepTrack is for construction contractors.
- [HR software for Singapore SMEs](https://ccorex.com/solutions/hr-software-singapore) (DeepHR): face and GPS attendance on staff phones, leave, claims, timesheets, multi-level approvals, and CPF, SDL and SHG payroll.
- [Payroll software for Singapore](https://ccorex.com/solutions/payroll-software-singapore) (DeepHR): CPF (incl. graduated PR rates), SDL and SHG on every pay run, MOM overtime and proration, itemised payslips and payroll reports. IR8A / AIS files in early access.
- [Attendance app for Singapore](https://ccorex.com/solutions/attendance-app-singapore) (DeepHR): face and GPS check-in on each employee's own phone, no kiosk, works offline, HR approves each session, hours flow to payroll.
- [Leave management system for Singapore](https://ccorex.com/solutions/leave-management-system-singapore) (DeepHR): leave applied on the phone, Singapore leave presets and public holidays, multi-level approvals, team calendar, payroll sync.

## Singapore contractor guides
- [Variation order template for Singapore contractors](https://ccorex.com/resources/variation-order-template-singapore), with an Excel VO form and register

- [Subcontractor progress claims: how main contractors assess and pay them](https://ccorex.com/resources/subcontractor-progress-claims-singapore): work done, retention, back-charges, SOP Act payment response, GST and records
- [Construction cost report template](https://ccorex.com/resources/construction-cost-report-template), with an Excel monthly cost report (budget, committed, actual, cost to complete, forecast)

## Free calculators
- [CPF contribution calculator](https://ccorex.com/tools/cpf-contribution-calculator): employer and employee CPF for a month with the CPF Board's 2026 rates, the $8,000 Ordinary Wage ceiling and graduated rates for 1st/2nd-year PRs.
- [Overtime pay calculator](https://ccorex.com/tools/overtime-pay-calculator): MOM's hourly basic rate formula, 1.5× rate, the $13.60 non-workman cap, Part 4 eligibility and the 72-hour monthly limit.
- [Construction foreign worker levy calculator](https://ccorex.com/tools/foreign-worker-levy-calculator): monthly and annual levy by source and R1/R2 tier, MOM's daily rate for part months, and quota and 10% R1 checks.
